s0001.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on bingwu new moon, Eastern Campaign branch secretariat left grand councillor and King of Koryo Wang Zhang dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods to congratulate the New Year's day.
s0001.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, on bingwu new moon, Eastern Campaign branch secretariat left grand councillor and King of Koryo Wang Zhang dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods to congratulate the New Year's day.

s0002.literal: Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned and instructed the barbarian chieftain Li Pingqing and others to submit.
s0002.idiomatic: Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned and instructed the barbarian chieftain Li Pingqing and others to submit.

s0003.literal: On wushen day Yuanjiang Route director-general Pushuang rebelled; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to summon and capture him.
s0003.idiomatic: On wushen day Yuanjiang Route director-general Pushuang rebelled; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to summon and capture him.

s0004.literal: Princes Xiechetu and Huanghuo Temür came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
s0004.idiomatic: Princes Xiechetu and Huanghuo Temür came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

s0005.literal: On renzi day Prince Kanchibuhua was enfeoffed Prince of Weishun and stationed at Huguang;
s0005.idiomatic: On renzi day Prince Kanchibuhua was enfeoffed Prince of Weishun and stationed at Huguang;

s0006.literal: Mainu was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanjing and stationed at Yidu;
s0006.idiomatic: Mainu was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanjing and stationed at Yidu;

s0007.literal: each was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
s0007.idiomatic: each was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

s0008.literal: Official fields in Shandong and Huguang were granted to the people for cultivation and reclamation — three qing per person — and cattle and implements were still provided.
s0008.idiomatic: Official fields in Shandong and Huguang were granted to the people for cultivation and reclamation — 3 qing per person — and cattle and implements were still provided.

s0009.literal: Prince Busiyin dispatched envoys presenting western horses.
s0009.idiomatic: Prince Busiyin dispatched envoys presenting western horses.

s0010.literal: Former Hanlin academician Wu Cheng was summoned but did not accept appointment.
s0010.idiomatic: Former Hanlin academician Wu Cheng was summoned but did not accept appointment.

s0011.literal: The Directorate of Waterways and State Farms was established at Songjiang to manage Jiangnan river channels and waterworks.
s0011.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways and State Farms was established at Songjiang to manage Jiangnan river channels and waterworks.

s0012.literal: On jiwei day notes were granted to the troops and people under Prince of Wuping Tagusibuhua — fifteen ingots per person.
s0012.idiomatic: On jiwei day notes were granted to the troops and people under Prince of Wuping Tagusibuhua — 15 ingots per person.

s0013.literal: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was stationed to guard the Ulus tribe.
s0013.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was stationed to guard the Ulus tribe.

s0014.literal: On xinyou day Venus encroached upon Outer Screen.
s0014.idiomatic: On xinyou day Venus encroached upon Outer Screen.

s0015.literal: On guihai day Duolienie was enfeoffed Duke of State; privy council director Satemishi was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.
s0015.idiomatic: On guihai day Duolienie was enfeoffed Duke of State; privy council director Satemishi was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0016.literal: On wuchen day Burma fell into disorder; its ruler Daliyabo dispatched envoys requesting troops and presented trained elephants and tribute goods.
s0016.idiomatic: On wuchen day Burma fell into disorder; its ruler Daliyabo dispatched envoys requesting troops and presented trained elephants and tribute goods.

s0017.literal: Ruan Kou of Annam raided Siming Route; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in preparing defenses.
s0017.idiomatic: Ruan Kou of Annam raided Siming Route; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in preparing defenses.

s0018.literal: Subordinate counties of Dadu Route suffered famine; sixty thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0018.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Dadu Route suffered famine; 60,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0019.literal: Enzhou suffered flooding; grain was issued for relief.
s0019.idiomatic: Enzhou suffered flooding; grain was issued for relief.

s0020.literal: Second month, on dingchou day rewards were offered for anyone who could first report treasonous plots or sorcerous bewitchment; a reward scale was established and proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0020.idiomatic: Second month, on dingchou day rewards were offered for anyone who could first report treasonous plots or sorcerous bewitchment; a reward scale was established and proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0021.literal: On gengchen day sixty thousand ingots of notes were granted to relieve impoverished Onggirad commoners under Prince of Lu Argasibuhua; Prince Lubin was made grand master of the imperial clan.
s0021.idiomatic: On gengchen day 60,000 ingots of notes were granted to relieve impoverished Onggirad commoners under Prince of Lu Argasibuhua; Prince Lubin was made grand master of the imperial clan.

s0022.literal: On renwu day Xu Wenjie, native official of Quanming Prefecture in Guangxi, led various Yao in rebellion, raided Mingying Prefecture, and killed acting prefect Li Deqing and others; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing them.
s0022.idiomatic: On renwu day Xu Wenjie, native official of Quanming Prefecture in Guangxi, led various Yao in rebellion, raided Mingying Prefecture, and killed acting prefect Li Deqing and others; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing them.

s0023.literal: Namatai was made privy council director.
s0023.idiomatic: Namatai was made privy council director.

s0024.literal: On jiashen day the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at the Hanlin National History Academy.
s0024.idiomatic: On jiashen day the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at the Hanlin National History Academy.

s0025.literal: On dinghai day the Central Secretariat requested cessation of the Yao campaign; an edict directed Prince Ordoe'erhan and others to withdraw their armies, while garrison troops were to remain as before.
s0025.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Central Secretariat requested cessation of the Yao campaign; an edict directed Prince Ordoe'erhan and others to withdraw their armies, while garrison troops were to remain as before.

s0026.literal: On jichou day wine-brewing was forbidden in Bianliang Route.
s0026.idiomatic: On jichou day wine-brewing was forbidden in Bianliang Route.

s0027.literal: On jiawu day Zhending's Yuhua Palace was repaired.
s0027.idiomatic: On jiawu day Zhending's Yuhua Palace was repaired.

s0028.literal: On yiwei day Buddhist rites to avert thunder were performed at Chongtian Gate.
s0028.idiomatic: On yiwei day Buddhist rites to avert thunder were performed at Chongtian Gate.

s0029.literal: On bingshen day a spirit hall for Emperor Xianzong was built at Lushi Temple; the granted name was Great Heavenly Source Extended Sage Temple.
s0029.idiomatic: On bingshen day a spirit hall for Emperor Xianzong was built at Lushi Temple; the granted name was Great Heavenly Source Extended Sage Temple.

s0030.literal: An edict directed that the 《Scripture Treasury》 be written in gold in Western script.
s0030.idiomatic: An edict directed that the 《Scripture Treasury》 be written in gold in Western script.

s0031.literal: On jiaxu day Shuxiang Temple was built on Mount Wutai; three hundred qing of fields were granted.
s0031.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Shuxiang Temple was built on Mount Wutai; 300 qing of fields were granted.

s0032.literal: Java dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0032.idiomatic: Java dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0033.literal: On gengzi day Communications Court commissioner Chanai was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0033.idiomatic: On gengzi day Communications Court commissioner Chanai was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0034.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0034.idiomatic: On jiachen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0035.literal: Prince Yetegubuhua and central secretariat officials Uburdula, Chanai, Shanseng, Xu Shijing, and Duoduo were ordered to remain and guard.
s0035.idiomatic: Prince Yetegubuhua and central secretariat officials Uburdula, Chanai, Shanseng, Xu Shijing, and Duoduo were ordered to remain and guard.

s0036.literal: The Directorate of Palace Physicians was established, rank 5b, subordinate to the Heir Apparent's Household.
s0036.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Physicians was established, rank 5b, subordinate to the Heir Apparent's Household.

s0037.literal: Subordinate counties of Guide Prefecture suffered river breaches; the people were famished; fifty-six thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0037.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Guide Prefecture suffered river breaches; the people were famished; 56,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0038.literal: Hejian, Baoding, and Zhending circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for four months.
s0038.idiomatic: Hejian, Baoding, and Zhending circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for 4 months.

s0039.literal: Jianchang Route suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0039.idiomatic: Jianchang Route suffered famine; 30,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0040.literal: Third month, on yisi new moon, the Emperor blamed himself for the lack of rain, ordered review and judgment of serious prisoners, and dispatched envoys to sacrifice separately at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Watercourses, famous mountains and great rivers, and temples and abbeys in the capital region.
s0040.idiomatic: Third month, on yisi new moon, the Emperor blamed himself for the lack of rain, ordered review and judgment of serious prisoners, and dispatched envoys to sacrifice separately at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Watercourses, famous mountains and great rivers, and temples and abbeys in the capital region.

s0041.literal: Annam's palace was invaded by Longzhou wanhu Zhao Xiongfei and others; they begged that the plundered goods be ordered returned; an edict directed Guangxi Circuit to dispatch officials to investigate.
s0041.idiomatic: Annam's palace was invaded by Longzhou wanhu Zhao Xiongfei and others; they begged that the plundered goods be ordered returned; an edict directed Guangxi Circuit to dispatch officials to investigate.

s0042.literal: On bingwu day Saturn encroached upon Well Scepter Star.
s0042.idiomatic: On bingwu day Saturn encroached upon Well Scepter Star.

s0043.literal: On dingwei day the hundred officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate on urgent affairs.
s0043.idiomatic: On dingwei day the hundred officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate on urgent affairs.

s0044.literal: Central secretariat officials and others requested reduction of guard soldiers, curbing of excessive rewards, cessation of construction and repair, defense against Yao raiders, and return of temple offices, yamens, and smelting affairs to the Central Secretariat — all were approved.
s0044.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials and others requested reduction of guard soldiers, curbing of excessive rewards, cessation of construction and repair, defense against Yao raiders, and return of temple offices, yamens, and smelting affairs to the Central Secretariat — all were approved.

s0045.literal: On renzi day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0045.idiomatic: On renzi day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0046.literal: On guichou day the barbarians of Eight Tribes Yannixia Cave submitted; they wished to deliver two thousand five hundred bolts of cloth annually; barbarian officials were established to pacify them.
s0046.idiomatic: On guichou day the barbarians of Eight Tribes Yannixia Cave submitted; they wished to deliver 2,500 bolts of cloth annually; barbarian officials were established to pacify them.

s0047.literal: On yimao day the people were again forbidden to weave gold-dragon patterned silks and cloths.
s0047.idiomatic: On yimao day the people were again forbidden to weave gold-dragon patterned silks and cloths.

s0048.literal: On dingsi day Prince Shila was dispatched to guard the northern frontier.
s0048.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince Shila was dispatched to guard the northern frontier.

s0049.literal: On wuwu day an edict pacified Burma and granted its ruler gold and silks.
s0049.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict pacified Burma and granted its ruler gold and silks.

s0050.literal: On jiazi day the Merit Affairs Commission was ordered to select one hundred twenty-seven annual Buddhist rites for repair.
s0050.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Merit Affairs Commission was ordered to select 127 annual Buddhist rites for repair.

s0051.literal: On bingyin day Hanlin academician-director Alintemur and Xu Shijing completed translating the 《Imperial Instructions》; it was renamed the 《Grand Chart of Imperial Instructions》, and an edict directed that it be conferred upon the crown prince.
s0051.idiomatic: On bingyin day Hanlin academician-director Alintemur and Xu Shijing completed translating the 《Imperial Instructions》; it was renamed the 《Grand Chart of Imperial Instructions》, and an edict directed that it be conferred upon the crown prince.

s0053.literal: Monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites at Lintao, Fengxiang, Xingjier Zong Mountain, and other places.
s0053.idiomatic: Monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites at Lintao, Fengxiang, Xingjier Zong Mountain, and other places.

s0054.literal: Princes Boluo Temür and Alaten were each granted two thousand ingots of notes.
s0054.idiomatic: Princes Boluo Temür and Alaten were each granted 2,000 ingots of notes.

s0055.literal: On wuchen day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation, and Saturn encroached upon Well.
s0055.idiomatic: On wuchen day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation, and Saturn encroached upon Well.

s0056.literal: On gengwu day Saturn, Venus, and Jupiter converged in Well.
s0056.idiomatic: On gengwu day Saturn, Venus, and Jupiter converged in Well.

s0057.literal: On xinwei day Ruan Fengzi of Quanzhou raised rebellion; he raided and seized walled cities; military and civilian officials were punished for failure to suppress him.
s0057.idiomatic: On xinwei day Ruan Fengzi of Quanzhou raised rebellion; he raided and seized walled cities; military and civilian officials were punished for failure to suppress him.

s0058.literal: Yongping, Weihui, Zhongshan, and Shunde circuits suffered famine; more than sixty-six thousand ingots of notes were issued for relief.
s0058.idiomatic: Yongping, Weihui, Zhongshan, and Shunde circuits suffered famine; more than 66,000 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

s0059.literal: Ningxia, Fengyuan, and Jianchang circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for two months.
s0059.idiomatic: Ningxia, Fengyuan, and Jianchang circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for 2 months.

s0060.literal: Dadu, Hejian, Baoding, Yongping, Jinan, and Changde circuits suffered famine; half their field rents were remitted.
s0060.idiomatic: Dadu, Hejian, Baoding, Yongping, Jinan, and Changde circuits suffered famine; half their field rents were remitted.

s0061.literal: Fourth month, on bingxu day Zhen'an Route director-general Cen Xiuguang was attacked by his younger brother Xiuren; he came to report it; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to investigate and settle the matter.
s0061.idiomatic: Fourth month, on bingxu day Zhen'an Route director-general Cen Xiuguang was attacked by his younger brother Xiuren; he came to report it; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to investigate and settle the matter.

s0062.literal: On wuxu day Venus encroached upon Ghost.
s0062.idiomatic: On wuxu day Venus encroached upon Ghost.

s0063.literal: On renyin day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0063.idiomatic: On renyin day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0064.literal: Rongmi Cave barbarian Tian Xianshiyong and others joined twelve cave barbarians in raiding Changyang County; the Huguang Branch Secretariat dispatched Nine Surnames chief official Peng Hudubuhua to summon them; Tian Xianshiyong and others of five caves submitted, and troops were dispatched against the remainder.
s0064.idiomatic: Rongmi Cave barbarian Tian Xianshiyong and others joined 12 cave barbarians in raiding Changyang County; the Huguang Branch Secretariat dispatched Nine Surnames chief official Peng Hudubuhua to summon them; Tian Xianshiyong and others of 5 caves submitted, and troops were dispatched against the remainder.

s0065.literal: Thirty-three river dikes at Xiajin and Wucheng were repaired; corvée laborers numbered seventeen thousand five hundred men.
s0065.idiomatic: 33 river dikes at Xiajin and Wucheng were repaired; corvée laborers numbered 17,500 men.

s0066.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen new moon, Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys presenting leopards.
s0066.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiachen new moon, Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys presenting leopards.

s0067.literal: On yisi day thirty-one Buddhist rites to avert thunder were repaired.
s0067.idiomatic: On yisi day 31 Buddhist rites to avert thunder were repaired.

s0068.literal: Gansu branch secretariat officials said: "At Chijin grain is stored, but supplying troops across the river is inconvenient because of the distance; we request that it again be moved to Quyou.
s0068.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat officials said, "At Chijin grain is stored, but supplying troops across the river is inconvenient because of the distance; we request that it again be moved to Quyou.

s0071.literal: Jing Prefecture suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.
s0071.idiomatic: Jing Prefecture suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.

s0072.literal: Manufacture of Fujian's annual tribute sugar syrup was abolished.
s0072.idiomatic: Manufacture of Fujian's annual tribute sugar syrup was abolished.

s0073.literal: Because Western monks disturbed the people by using relay stations, this was forbidden.
s0073.idiomatic: Because Western monks disturbed the people by using relay stations, this was forbidden.

s0074.literal: On jiayin day the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians of the southern circuit dispatched their son Zhao Santing to present tribute goods at court.
s0074.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians of the southern circuit dispatched their son Zhao Santing to present tribute goods at court.

s0075.literal: On yimao day the Imperial Preceptor's elder brother Suonanzangbu was put in charge of the three Western circuits pacification commissions, was given a princess in marriage, and was granted a princely title.
s0075.idiomatic: On yimao day the Imperial Preceptor's elder brother Suonanzangbu was put in charge of the 3 Western circuits pacification commissions, was given a princess in marriage, and was granted a princely title.

s0076.literal: Princess Shouning was granted a seal; one hundred qing of fields and thirty thousand ingots of notes were still granted.
s0076.idiomatic: Princess Shouning was granted a seal; 100 qing of fields and 30,000 ingots of notes were still granted.

s0077.literal: On jiazi day the Central Secretariat reviewed the year's note receipts and disbursements and requested economizing to make up the shortfall; this was approved.
s0077.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Central Secretariat reviewed the year's note receipts and disbursements and requested economizing to make up the shortfall; this was approved.

s0078.literal: Supervising censor impeached pacification commissioner Duorzhiban and academicians Li Talahi and Liu Shaozu as vulgar and incompetent.
s0078.idiomatic: Supervising censor impeached pacification commissioner Duorzhiban and academicians Li Talahi and Liu Shaozu as vulgar and incompetent.

s0079.literal: The Central Secretariat deliberated: "All three are sons and grandsons of meritorious ministers; there are no substantiated charges; we request that their posts be restored, and that the Censorate still be directed not to impeach on empty words.
s0079.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat deliberated, "All three are sons and grandsons of meritorious ministers; there are no substantiated charges; we request that their posts be restored, and that the Censorate still be directed not to impeach on empty words.

s0081.literal: On dingmao day Cen Shixing and Zhen'an Route's Cen Xiuwen joined mountain Liao and Jiao barbarians numbering more than sixty thousand in raiding; the Huguang and Yunnan branch secretariats were ordered to summon and instruct them.
s0081.idiomatic: On dingmao day Cen Shixing and Zhen'an Route's Cen Xiuwen joined mountain Liao and Jiao barbarians numbering more than 60,000 in raiding; the Huguang and Yunnan branch secretariats were ordered to summon and instruct them.

s0082.literal: Commander Uduman was dispatched to inscribe Western incantations on the cliff stones at Juyong Pass.
s0082.idiomatic: Commander Uduman was dispatched to inscribe Western incantations on the cliff stones at Juyong Pass.

s0083.literal: On gengwu day Qizhu summoned and instructed the five-cave Yao of Yongming County to submit.
s0083.idiomatic: On gengwu day Qizhu summoned and instructed the 5-cave Yao of Yongming County to submit.

s0084.literal: Four tribes of Jiamulong in Hexi submitted; Da'ermaban Zangbu was put in charge of the Buralmashuo tribe; Gonggeban was put in charge of the Gulungluo Wugong Yuanzong Lanzong Bu'erjian Shajiajian tribe; Suonanjian Zangbu was put in charge of the Lanzong Gubulabujili Xijilin Yimushi Weishi tribe; Duorzhibenla was put in charge of the Longdachilie Bali Aboludasi Adazang tribe.
s0084.idiomatic: Four tribes of Jiamulong in Hexi submitted; Da'ermaban Zangbu was put in charge of the Buralmashuo tribe; Gonggeban was put in charge of the Gulungluo Wugong Yuanzong Lanzong Bu'erjian Shajiajian tribe; Suonanjian Zangbu was put in charge of the Lanzong Gubulabujili Xijilin Yimushi Weishi tribe; Duorzhibenla was put in charge of the Longdachilie Bali Aboludasi Adazang tribe.

s0085.literal: Xiong Prefecture suffered famine; Taiping and Xinghua subordinate counties suffered flooding — all were relieved.
s0085.idiomatic: Xiong Prefecture suffered famine; Taiping and Xinghua subordinate counties suffered flooding — all were relieved.

s0086.literal: Luzhou, Yulin Prefecture, and Hongze garrison fields suffered drought; fiscal and official fields in subordinate counties of Yangzhou Route suffered flooding — all their rents were remitted.
s0086.idiomatic: Luzhou, Yulin Prefecture, and Hongze garrison fields suffered drought; fiscal and official fields in subordinate counties of Yangzhou Route suffered flooding — all their rents were remitted.

s0087.literal: Sixth month, on guiyou new moon, Prince Qiebie was granted a seven-treasures girdle.
s0087.idiomatic: Sixth month, on guiyou new moon, Prince Qiebie was granted a seven-treasures girdle.

s0088.literal: Tuhatiemur was made Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor;
s0088.idiomatic: Tuhatiemur was made Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor;

s0089.literal: he requested to complete mourning for his mother; this was approved.
s0089.idiomatic: he requested to complete mourning for his mother; this was approved.

s0090.literal: On guiwei day Bozhou barbarian Li Ping'ai rebelled again; joining Xie Wuqiong he raided; pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned Ping'ai to come out and submit.
s0090.idiomatic: On guiwei day Bozhou barbarian Li Ping'ai rebelled again; joining Xie Wuqiong he raided; pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned Ping'ai to come out and submit.

s0091.literal: Wuqiong did not submit; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to suppress him.
s0091.idiomatic: Wuqiong did not submit; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to suppress him.

s0092.literal: On dinghai day Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was ordered to go out and guard the territory of Ananda.
s0092.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was ordered to go out and guard the territory of Ananda.

s0093.literal: On wuzi day Princes Toghto and others came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
s0093.idiomatic: On wuzi day Princes Toghto and others came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

s0094.literal: On yiwei day Prince of Liang Wangshan and Prince Cheche Tu were ordered to pacify the northern army; Wangshan was granted five thousand ingots of notes and two hundred bolts each of silks and cloths.
s0094.idiomatic: On yiwei day Prince of Liang Wangshan and Prince Cheche Tu were ordered to pacify the northern army; Wangshan was granted 5,000 ingots of notes and 200 bolts each of silks and cloths.

s0095.literal: On dingyou day the Daoist Wu Quanjie was dispatched to perform jiao rites at the three mountains of Longhu, Sanmao, and Gezao.
s0095.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Daoist Wu Quanjie was dispatched to perform jiao rites at the 3 mountains of Longhu, Sanmao, and Gezao.

s0096.literal: On wuxu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the salt-pond spirit of Jie Prefecture.
s0096.idiomatic: On wuxu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the salt-pond spirit of Jie Prefecture.

s0097.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Recently prefectures and counties have suffered drought and locusts — this is because we could not harmonize and govern.
s0097.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Recently prefectures and counties have suffered drought and locusts — this is because we could not harmonize and govern.

s0098.literal: Now we ought to be fearful and examine ourselves, exert ourselves in good government, and also hope that Your Majesty will respectfully and cautiously cultivate virtue and pity and succor the living people.
s0098.idiomatic: Now we ought to be fearful and examine ourselves, exert ourselves in good government, and also hope that Your Majesty will respectfully and cautiously cultivate virtue and pity and succor the living people.

s0099.literal: " The Emperor commended and approved it.
s0099.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and approved it.

s0100.literal: Forty thousand ingots of notes were issued to relieve Prince of Chang Bala Temür's following; Prince of Wu Pobi was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0100.idiomatic: 40,000 ingots of notes were issued to relieve Prince of Chang Bala Temür's following; Prince of Wu Pobi was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.
